Yesterday your agent remembered. Today it plugs into the world — and can take back-and-forth,
Every new agent re-builds. Every new tool re-wires. This doesn't scale.
MCP is the USB-C of AI tools — one protocol that lets ANY
LLM app talk to ANY tool or data source.
Open-sourced by Anthropic, Nov 2024. Every major SaaS is shipping one in 2026.
Server = the integration. Host + Client = the agent app. User talks to Host. Host dispatches via Client
JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio or HTTP. Readable, debuggable, boring. That's the point — boring
For today's projects: stdio for local, HTTP for shared. Pick by deployment.
Slide 8 — Existing MCP servers you can use today
smithery.ai and the official modelcontextprotocol/servers repo. 200+ servers and climbing.

Enter LangGraph — agents as state machines
LangChain agents are a loop. LangGraph agents are a graph. You can draw them, debug them, pause
Why LangGraph? Why not LangChain forever?
Use LangChain for prototypes. Reach for LangGraph when flow matters or production demands it.

look like under the hood in 2026.
